title: Problem-solving competency drove evolution long before brains

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Problem-solving competency drove evolution long before brains

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: The authors suggest that intelligence, understood as problem-solving competency, was an evolutionary driver long before complex brains and muscle-driven behaviour arose, so basal cognition is an important part of evolutionary developmental biology.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Cellular Competency during Development Alters Evolutionary Dynamics in an Artificial Embryogeny Model

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Shreesha L 2023, Cellular Competency during Development Alters Evolutionary Dynamics in an Artificial Embryogeny Model › 5. Conclusions

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: and that intelligence (problem-solving competency) was an evolutionary driver long before complex brains and muscle-driven behavior arose [52,53,56,136,137,138,139,140,141,142,143].

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Shreesha L, Levin M, “Cellular Competency during Development Alters Evolutionary Dynamics in an Artificial Embryogeny Model”, Entropy (Basel, Switzerland) (2023), doi:10.3390/e25010131; section “5. Conclusions”. Scope: Evolution of life before nervous systems

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2023-competency-14: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.36

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Modern comparative evidence can establish that non-neural adaptive capacities are ancient and widespread. It has weak power to identify them as a causal evolutionary driver in deep time.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Define pre-neural problem solving as adaptive error correction toward measurable physiological or morphological setpoints, reconstruct its phylogenetic age, and test whether variation predicts evolutionary transitions. Evidence predating nervous systems supports antiquity but not necessarily that it was a driver.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Direct observations before brains are impossible.

Deep-time driver claims are hard to separate from correlated cellular functions.

Problem-solving competency has contested operationalizations.

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The authors equate intelligence with problem-solving competency and assert it was an evolutionary driver before brains. A non-cognitive description of the same early bodies and developmental mechanisms fits every available fossil and phylogenetic pattern. The claim does not add a measurement that would decide between those descriptions.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: No public observation separates 'problem-solving competency drove evolution before brains' from the statement that developmental mechanisms affected fitness before nervous systems existed. Fossils and phylogenies show early morphological complexity either way.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
No dataset records problem-solving competency as a causal variable in deep time.

Pre-neural morphological complexity is compatible with competency as a driver and with competency as a label for ordinary development.
